content.title: Chapter 38 - ENVIRONMENT — Sec. 38-95. - Correction for character of sound.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to operate or cause or permit to be operated any
               stationary source of noise which emits a pure tone, cyclically varying noise or repetitively
               impulsive noise which exceeds five dB(A) less than the limits set in
section 38-91
.
